acceptance: A DataFrame run of TPC-DS, SSB and ClickBench reports PASSED or FAILED, not UNCERTAIN or NOT_RUN, at the scales the provider supports
The supported benchmark and scale combinations are documented, and unsupported ones still report UNCERTAIN
description: query_validation.py returns UNCERTAIN for TPC-DS and for TPC-H at scales other than 1, and NOT_RUN for SSB and ClickBench. DataFrame runs on those benchmarks therefore never produce a validated result, and correctness has to be established by other means (the cross-surface gate at SF 0.1 against a DuckDB SQL reference). Add a validation provider, for example a reference row-count or result-hash oracle per benchmark and scale, so a DataFrame run can report PASSED where it is correct. Recorded as an out-of-scope follow-up of the Polars matrix work.
